title: Why Does Crypto Move So Fast? Volatility Explained (Beginner Guide)
caption: Crypto prices can swing sharply in a day. Here is why, in simple words.

scenes.head: WHY SO WILD?
scenes.narration: Crypto prices can jump or drop a lot in a single day. Why does it move so fast?

scenes.head: A YOUNG MARKET
scenes.narration: Crypto is a young and smaller market than stocks. Fewer buyers and sellers means each big order can move the price.

scenes.head: OPEN ALL DAY
scenes.narration: Crypto trades day and night, every day of the year. News can hit the price at any hour, even on weekends.

scenes.head: NEWS AND MOOD
scenes.narration: Headlines, rumors and mood shift quickly. Fear and excitement can push prices in both directions.

scenes.head: LEVERAGE ADDS FUEL
scenes.narration: Some traders borrow money to bet bigger. When prices move against them, forced sales can speed up a drop.

scenes.head: WHAT BEGINNERS CAN DO
scenes.narration: Many educators suggest using only money you can afford to lose, expecting big swings, and learning first.
